notes: G21 p. 10: a weekly employee (under 65) starts on the 5th day of a 7-day week and receives R1 090 for 3 days. Decimal portion 3 / 7 = 0.4285 (as printed); annual equivalent 1 090 / 0.4285 x 52 = 132275.38; tax 18% - 17 820 = 5989.57; x 0.4285 / 52 = 49.36. SARS prints R5 966 and R49 from the banded annual table; the case asserts the formula to the cent. Week Mon 29 June - Sun 5 July 2026, start Friday 3 July. UIF 1% = 10.90.
